correctness.rationale: The claim was reconstructed from Lei--Bickel Theorem 2 in the exact scalar saturated parameter regime. The projection residual equals a cyclic-orbit affine altitude; unitary DFT diagonalization gives the reciprocal-spectrum altitude formula, including the zero-frequency affine-dependence case. For a two-one binary vector the spectrum is \(4\cos^2(\pi k d/n)\); residue counting and the odd-\(N\) secant-square identity yield \((O^*)^2=4n/(nN-1)\), while even \(N\) gives a zero Fourier mode. Divisor monotonicity gives the global optimizer. The bundled dependency-free checker independently reconstructs the residual and exhaustively confirms all separations for \(3\le n\le30\). The proved statement is explicitly only the design proxy, not full test power.

value.rationale: The source explicitly motivates row pre-ordering because \(O^*\) can vary materially and frames its general maximization as an NP-hard nonlinear traveling-salesman problem. Exactly two active rows is a natural rare-binary-predictor design, not an arbitrary numeric slice. The theorem completely solves that row-ordering family, exposes a qualitative arithmetic obstruction (every ordering collapses exactly at power-of-two sample sizes), and gives a concrete 5 percent minimal-sample consequence at \(n=20\) where only four of nineteen oriented spacings avoid collapse. This provides a diagnostic and exact benchmark for a practically motivated design sensitivity while carefully avoiding a claim about full test power.
